{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders using the cleaned column (value 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order examples:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']])

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders from completed orders
completed_no_qa = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue_no_qa = completed_no_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_no_qa}")"}
